notes.title: Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt Enhanced Edition is out now!
notes.notes:
Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt Enhanced Edition is Out Now – And It’s Free!

Hey Strike Force fans,

The wait is over! [b]Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt Enhanced Edition is now available[/b] on PC and PS5, and the best part? It’s a [b]FREE[/b] upgrade for all existing owners! 🎉

[b]What’s New in the Enhanced Edition?[/b]
✔ Massively upgraded visuals – improved lighting, shadows, water, and foliage for a more immersive experience.
✔ Reworked levels – refined environments and enhanced rendering quality.
✔ Overhauled AI – smarter enemies bring more intense tactical action.
✔ PANet integration – track your stats, unlock achievements, and earn Polygon Art Prestige Points at [url=www.polygon-art.com/stats]www.polygon-art.com/stats[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41102571/71adadbc00bea46076c9dc589fcd1bc0bacd8bd1.jpg[/img]

If you already own Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt, just update your game and jump into the action with all these amazing upgrades! If you haven’t played yet, now’s the perfect time to experience the ultimate tactical shooter in its best form.

Download the Enhanced Edition now and let us know what you think!

– The Polygon Art Team

notes.title: Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt Enhanced Edition is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Big News: Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt Enhanced Edition is Coming Soon – And It’s Free!

Hey Strike Force fans,

We’ve got some exciting news to share! We’re bringing Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt Enhanced Edition to PC and PS5 in the near future. While we’re not ready to reveal the exact release date just yet, we couldn’t wait to give you a sneak peek at what’s coming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41102571/71adadbc00bea46076c9dc589fcd1bc0bacd8bd1.jpg[/img]

The Enhanced Edition takes everything you love about Strike Force 2 and cranks it up a notch! The visuals have been massively upgraded to deliver an even more immersive experience. You’ll notice stunning improvements to light, shadows, water, and vegetation—making every mission feel more alive than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41102571/ef16b2bf52194b36f41824b4300b91efeb510bfc.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all. We’ve also integrated PANet—Polygon Art’s online stats and achievement system! You can now track your stats and in-game achievements at www.polygon-art.com/stats. Best of all, Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt Enhanced Edition will be the first game where you can earn Polygon Art Achievements and rack up Polygon Art Prestige Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41102571/97951bfcbad83065b71f12f0c2db0d6779292bed.jpg[/img]

And here’s the best part: If you already own Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt, the Enhanced Edition will be released as a free update! That’s right—no extra cost to enjoy all the upgrades and new features.

Stay tuned for the release date announcement and get ready to dive into the ultimate Strike Force experience. In the meantime, sharpen your skills—this Enhanced Edition is going to be epic!

Let us know what you think!

– The Polygon Art Team

[b]Wishlist Strike Force Joint Ops now:[/b]

notes.title: Unreal Engine 5 - Ray Tracing Update | 1.5.0
notes.notes:
[h2]STRIKE FORCE 2 - TERRORIST HUNT DOES NOW SUPPORT RAY TRACED GLOBAL ILLUMINATION AND REFLECTIONS![/h2]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] updated engine from Unreal Engine 4.26 to 5.1
[*] updated to newer DLSS version
[*] added option for Ray Tracing (Highend Systems only) Global Illumination and Reflections
[/list]

If you want to play the old Unreal Engine 4 version, switch to the [u]ue4_legacy[/u] branch.

Comparison between the regular Screen Space Global Illumination and Reflections and the new Ray Traced versions:

notes.title: Update 1.2.5 - Temporary FOV options
notes.notes:
This update adds a temporary solution to Field of View issues on Ultra Widescreen Monitors. 
The Field of View option is now available in the settings menu and allows the set the FOV in a range from 80-140 (default: 90).

Please be advised this is a temporary solution and can cause animation issues on non ultra wide displayes.

notes.title: Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt is now available!
notes.notes:
[h2]Strike Force 2 - Terrorist Hunt is now available![/h2]

The waiting is finally over!

You are a member of the Strike Force Unit. Your objective is to rescue our agent and combat the terrorist organization. Gear up with a modern arsenal of machine guns, assault rifles, sniper rifles and pistols and fulfill your objective.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] A tropical paradise turned into a warzone - explore exotic locations and claustrophobic bunker complexes.
[*] Complete a tense 8 mission long campaign and protect the free world.
[*] Utilize a modern arsenal of machine guns, assault rifles, sniper rifles and pistols.
[*] Dual Render Scopes
[*] Nvidia DLSS support
[/list]
